messages.text: tell me a short story on the context for this relay project, how tickets have evolved

Relay is basically the app building itself: a local-first Electron kanban where each project folder owns durable work in `.relay/`, and Codex (later Cursor/Claude too) runs *on* tickets instead of replacing them.
Early tickets were flat “ship a thing” cards—README hello-world, provider switching, injecting `.relay/context/` into agent prompts. The board then grew hierarchy (epic → feature → lean tasks), container review gates, and stricter drag rules (Todo → Ready queue, Not Doing defer/revert). Most of that shipped and landed in **Archive** (39 of 43); what’s left in **Ready** is polish—lean dependencies, archive-with-summary, and archiving whole epic/feature bundles from detail—plus one old Todo smoke test still sitting there.
